title: fix(plugin-grid): bulk confirm step names records by display title, on every path (objectui#12332)
body:
Fixes #12332
Clause-②: no

The bulk-action confirm step now names every affected record by its display title, through `getRecordDisplayName` (`@object-ui/core`), the one ADR-0079 resolver the delete confirm and the record header already use. This holds for the per-record (bare-string `bulkActions`) path and the aggregate path alike.

Implemented by `os-dev` for the `domain:ui` seat, branch `claude/issue-12332-bulk-confirm-titles`.

## Premise check: the defect follows the object, not the dispatch path

The reporter's narrowing attributed the raw ids to the bare-string fan-out path, with `mass_update_stage` (aggregate) as the working control. Measured on `main` `52d6194`, both paths hand `BulkActionDialog` the same `rows`, and the dialog named each row by `row[labelKey]`. `labelKey` defaulted to `'name'`, and no caller ever passed it. So any object whose title field is not literally `name` listed ids, on either path.

- HotCRM's `crm_lead` declares `nameField: 'display_title'` and has no `name` field, so Add to Campaign listed ids.
- `crm_opportunity` declares `nameField: 'name'`, so `mass_update_stage` listed names. The control and the defect ran on two different objects.

The new pin runs both paths on the same lead-shaped object. With the fix reverted, both paths list ids (see Ablation below). So the producer was the dialog's hard-coded `'name'` guess, fed by a grid that never handed over its object definition. It was not the per-row runner. The fix is in the producer, `ObjectGrid` (it now hands the dialog `objectDef={objectSchema}`), and in the one place the list is drawn. There is no second title lookup and no per-path branch.

#12119's mechanism (`resolvePromotedBulkParams`) resolves the action's params. It does not name the selected rows, so it was not reusable here. Record naming already has its own shared resolver, and this PR reuses that.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`: the `labelKey` prop (default `'name'`, zero callers) is replaced by `objectDef`. Each row is named by `getRecordDisplayName(objectDef, row)`. The ladder is `nameField`, then the deprecated alias, then `titleFormat`, then type-aware derivation, then name-ish record keys. A row with nothing resolvable reads `Record #` followed by its id, which marks it as an id. An id-less row keeps the existing `grid.bulk.rowFallback` copy. `BulkActionDialog` is not exported from `@object-ui/plugin-grid`'s index, so no published face moves (Clause-②: no).
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: one prop, `objectDef={objectSchema}`, on the dialog mount.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`: one paragraph on what the confirm step lists.
- `.changeset/12332-bulk-confirm-titles.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

## Tests

New `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkConfirmRecordTitles-12332.test.tsx` (4 cases). Each drives the real `ObjectGrid` and `BulkActionDialog` and reads the confirm step's list items:

- bare-string `bulkActions: ['create_campaign']` on an object with `nameField: 'display_title'` lists `Mira Costa - Atlas Construction` and `Kai Watanabe - Coral Reef Hotels`;
- aggregate `bulkActionDefs` on the same object lists the same titles;
- a row with no resolvable title lists `Record #q1`;
- CONTROL: an object titled by `name` still lists its name.

Results, all at `00c72b7`:

- **Bulk set:** the 16 bulk-action suites, including #12119's `bulkFieldBackedParam-12105` pins and `objectBulkActionDispatch`. `Test Files 16 passed`, measured before the fixture-only fix commit, when the one red case was the title-less fixture. The full project run below supersedes it.
- **Full project:** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/` gave `Test Files 212 passed (212)`, `Tests 1924 passed (1924)`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (it runs `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the test files are covered) exited 0. That was after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'` (exit 0).
- **Ablation:** `BulkActionDialog.tsx` and `ObjectGrid.tsx` were reset to `52d6194`, and the change was proven on disk: resolver call 1 to 0, `row[labelKey]` read 0 to 1, grid `objectDef` prop 1 to 0. Result: bare-string red, aggregate red (`expected [ 'NZlnBCoFRGzxCw4O', ... ]`), title-less red (`'q1'`), CONTROL green. After the restore, both blobs equal HEAD's (`0e33d2d`, `8636f61`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the run is 4/4 green.

## Gates

Each gate's exit code was recorded on its own, at `484797a`. The commit after it touches only the test fixture.

- **Exit 0:** `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:doc-fences`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` (3 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-control-bytes`.
- **Exit 1, known on `main`:** `check:spec-floors` ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec ..."). This is objectui#12334, recorded and not fixed here.
- **Lint, narrowed:** `eslint` over the 3 changed source and test files, run from `packages/plugin-grid` the way its `lint` script (`eslint .`) runs: exit 0, 0 errors. The root `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Projection.** The grid's `$select` is built from the view's columns plus its harvests (predicates, grouping, the concurrency token). It does not add the object's `nameField`. When a view does not show the `nameField` column, a row arrives without it, and the resolver falls to its next rung. On HotCRM Leads, whose columns show `full_name` and not `display_title`, the step should read the person's name (for example `Mira Costa`) rather than the full `Mira Costa - Atlas Construction`. This was not measured in a browser. Either way it is a name and not an id. Harvesting `nameField` into the projection would change every grid's wire query, so it is left out of this card and raised in the report for the seat to rule on.
- The single-row delete confirm reads the same resolver over the same projected row, so it has the same limit.
